title: Jithendar.com · Overview
description: Traffic, errors and latency (from Next.js server spans), site figures and runtime for jithendar.com. Metrics: http://<pod>:9464/metrics (jithendar.com repo, services/www/src/lib/metrics.ts). Health probes (/api/health) are left out of request panels.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Requests handled by Next.js (pages, RSC, API, server actions), 5-minute rate.

panels.title: 4xx rate
panels.description: Includes normal 404s from bots.

panels.title: Pods up
panels.description: Site pods answering metrics scrapes (2 replicas).

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Requests per route pattern over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="jithendar-com", route!~"other|/api/health"}[10m]))))

panels.title: 5xx by route
panels.description: Empty is good.

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: IndexNow and other background jobs that used all retries.

panels.title: Database
panels.description: 1 = the database answered the last metrics query.

panels.title: Emails
panels.description: Transactional emails per hour (verification, reset, contact).

panels.title: Comments submitted
panels.description: Per hour, by resulting status.

panels.title: Event-loop delay (p99)
panels.description: Over ~0.1 s means the server is busy and pages wait.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Time spent throttled by the CPU limit.

panels.title: Cache bus subscribers
panels.description: Site pods whose cache-bus subscriber is connected to Valkey (src/lib/cache-bus.ts). No data = CACHE_BUS_REDIS_URL not configured; 0 for 15 min fires CacheBusDisconnected.

panels.title: Cache bus publishers
panels.description: Site pods whose cache-bus publisher is connected. The publisher connects at start; a pod with 0 still clears its own caches, the others wait for the TTL.

panels.title: Valkey memory
panels.description: Used memory of the fullest Valkey pod as a share of maxmemory (512 MB). volatile-lru: at 100 % only keys with a TTL are evicted, writes of keys without one fail (OOM).

panels.title: Valkey evicted keys
panels.description: Keys evicted since the pods started. Must stay 0: an eviction means memory was full.

panels.title: Valkey keyspace hit ratio
panels.description: Key lookups that found the key, 1 hour, all tenants (the cache bus does no key lookups).

panels.title: Valkey pub/sub channels
panels.description: Active pub/sub channels on the primary (jithendar:invalidate counts once however many pods subscribe).

panels.title: Cache invalidations / s
panels.description: Published by a pod (left on that pod) and received from another pod and applied, by cache kind. Received ≈ published × (pods − 1).

panels.title: Cache bus errors
panels.description: Connection and publish errors by role, per 5 minutes. A failed publish means that invalidation reaches the other pods only after the cache TTL.

panels.title: Valkey memory used vs maxmemory
panels.description: Per pod. maxmemory is 512 MB (deploy/minikube/redis/values.yaml in the miniKube repo).

panels.title: Valkey connected clients
panels.description: Per pod, all tenants. redis_exporter does not split this per ACL user; per user: valkey-cli CLIENT LIST (docs/redis-site-cachebus.md).

panels.title: Page cache hit ratio (1h)
panels.description: Share of ISR page cache lookups answered from memory over the last hour, all site pods (cache-handler.mjs). Low after a deploy or a burst of edits; a steady low value means pages are evicted (raise PAGE_CACHE_MAX_MB) or cleared too often.

panels.title: Cached pages
panels.description: Pages and route responses in the page cache, summed over site pods (each pod keeps its own copy).

panels.title: Page cache memory (max pod)
panels.description: Approximate memory of the largest pod's page cache; PAGE_CACHE_MAX_MB (64 by default) caps it and evicts the least recently used pages.

panels.title: Last warm-up: pages failed
panels.description: Pages the last warm-up could not render (5xx or no answer), worst pod (src/lib/warm.ts). Anything above 0: check the logs for "pages warmed".

panels.title: Page cache lookups / s
panels.description: Hits are served from memory in milliseconds; misses render the page from Postgres (first visit after a clear, an expired page, or the warm-up itself).

panels.title: Cache clears and warm-ups
panels.description: Clears (a content or settings change, per pod) and warm-up runs by reason and outcome; warm-up duration p95 on the right axis would be jithendar_page_warmup_duration_seconds.
